pdos_summary: VBM character stays S-3p (S dominates the top ~1.5 eV of the VB, Li/P/Cl minor). O-2p states are BURIED 2.3-5.5 eV below the VBM (deep O band at -5.6~-5.0 hybridized with P = the P-O bonding states; secondary O feature at -2.4~-2.3), i.e. O introduces NO states at either band edge -> why the gap is preserved and clean. CB onset ~2.05 eV mixed Li/P/S.
